description: A merged assistant-run message now covers the range the client already rendered. Pins the delta reset contract: displayProjectionSupersedesRenderedEvent fires and the server demands a full reset instead of an incremental delta.
note: Contract-shaped fixture, not a byte-exact server capture. The reset trigger condition (mergedStartSeq <= afterSeq && boundarySeq > afterSeq) is authoritative per chat/router-session-main-routes.mjs:144-152.

renderedBeforeMerge.comment: Client previously rendered seq 1-3 as separate assistant message chunks. Server-side compaction/merge collapsed them into one merged message whose boundary is seq 7.

mergedMessage.content: First I'll scan the entry points. …(full merged assistant message)…

clientDeltaRequest.comment: Client asks for events newer than its rendered cursor (3).

expectedClientBehavior.comment: Client must NOT apply this delta. It discards it and falls back to a full fetchSessionVisibleEventsPage(direction:'latest', limit:50), then getEventRenderPlan classifies the result as a reset (event-count shrink / seq regression relative to the merged range).
